spans.s:
f. (-पा)
A tree, (Dalbergia Sisu.)
2 The Asoka tree.
E.
शीघ्र quick, or शीर्ष the head or top; पा to cherish, or पत to fall, &c, aff. क or ड, deriv. irr.

m. (-निः)
A proper name, a chief of the Kṣatriya tribe.
E.
शि to make thin or small, Uṇādi aff. नि.

m. (-प्ता)
A name of SĀTYAKI, one of the chiefs of the Pāṇḍus.
E.
शिनि a proper name, and नप्तृ grandson.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Thick, congealed, (as oil or butter.)
m. (-नः)
1 A fool, a blockhead.
2 A large snake.
E.
श्यै to go, aff. क्त.

mf. (-नः-नी)
One-eyed.
m. (-नः)
A mouthful, or such a quantity bound together.
E.
षि to bind, नक् Uṇādi aff. or षि to bind, क्त aff. in this particular application.

m. (-हः)
1 A lion.
2 LEO, the sign of the zodiac.
3 (In composition) Pre-eminent.
f. (-ही)
1 The egg-plant, (Solanum Melongena.)
2 A shrub, (Justicia.)
3 A prickly nightshade.
4 The mother of RĀHU.
E.
षिच to sprinkle, क Uṇādi aff. ह substituted for the final, and नुम् inserted; or हिसि to injure or kill, अच् aff., and the radical consonants transposed.

m. (-लिः)
A Bauddha saint, also named MAÑJUGHOṢA.

m. (-रः)
1 A lion's mane.
2 A plant, (Mimusops elengi.)
E.
सिंह a lion, and केशर a mane, &c.

m. (-लः)
The open hands joined.
E.
सिंह a lion, and तल the open palm; also read संहतल.

m. (-ण्डः)
A kind of fish.
E.
सिंह, and तुण्ड face.

n. (-रं)
A gate, an entrance, especially the chief gate of a mansion or palace.
E.
सिंह chief, and द्वार a door-way.

m. (-निः)
1 The roar or sound of a lion.
2 A war cry.
E.
सिंह, and ध्वनि sound.

mfn. (-र्द्दी-र्द्दिनी-र्द्दि)
Roaring like a lion.
E.
सिंह, and नर्द्दिन् who or what sounds.

m. (-दः)
War-cry, war-hoop, shouting or roaring upon making an onset.
E.
सिंह a lion, and नाद cry.

m. (-कः)
1 The roar or yelp of a lion.
2 War-cry.
f. (-का)
A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.)
E.
सिंह a lion, नाद sounding, and कन् added.

f. (-र्णी)
A plant, (Justicia adhenatoda.)
E.
सिंह a lion, and पर्ण a leaf.

f. (-च्छी)
A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.)
E.
सिंह a lion, and पुच्छ tail; also with कन् added, सिंहपुच्छिका.

f. (-ना)
DURGĀ.
E.
सिंह a lion, and यान a vehicle.

f. (-था)
The goddess DURGĀ.
E.
सिंह a lion, and रथ a vehicle, mounted on that animal.

m. (-न्तः)
A horse.
E.
सिंह a lion, and विक्रान्त valour.

Tin.
2

Brass.
3

Cassia bark.
nf. (-लं-ला)
Ceylon.
E.
सिंह a lion, &c., ला to give or get, aff. क.

m. (-नः)
A tree, apparently a sort of palm.
E.
सिंहला Ceylon, and स्थान place.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Handsome and well-shaped.
E.
सिंह the beast, सहनन rivalling or surpassing.

mfn. (-ढ्यः-ढ्या-ढ्यं)
Abounding with lions.
E.
सिंह, and आद्य wealthy.

n. (-णं)
1 Rust of iron; also सिंहान.
2 The mucus of the nose.
E.
see the next.

n. (-नं)
1 Rust of iron.
2 The mucus of the nose.
E.
शिधि, to smell, आनक् aff., form irr.; also शिङ्घाण, सिंहाण, सिङ्घाण, &c.

n. (-नं)
A throne.
E.
सिंह a lion, (supported by lions, &c. wrought in gold,) and आसन a seat.

m. (-स्यः)
A plant, (Justicia adhenatoda, &c.)
E.
सिंह a lion, and आस्य the face; to which the flowers are compared.

f. (-का)
The mother of RĀHU.
E.
सिंही a lioness, कन् aff. of comparison, &c.

m. (-नुः)
The personified ascending node.
E.
सिंहिका the mother of RĀHU, and सूनु son.

f. (-ली)
1 The day preceding that of new moon, or that on which the moon rises scarcely visible.
2 The goddess UMĀ.
E.
सा good fortune, इनि aff., fem. form, सिनी a digit of the moon, वल to contain, aff. अण्, fem. aff. ङीष्; several other etymologies occur.

m. (-कः)
A small tree, (Vitex negundo.)
E.
स्यन्द to ooze, aff. उ, and कन् added; the semivowel of the root changed to इ.

m. (-रः)
A small tree, (Vitex negundo.)
E.
सिन्दु oozing, (as before,) वृ to screen or choose, aff. अण्.

n. (-रं)
Red lead, minium.
m. (-रः)
A sort of tree.
f. (-री)
1 Red cloth or clothes.
2 Rocani, (a sort of Crinum.)
3 A plant, (Lythrum fruticosum.)
E.
स्यन्द to ooze, Uṇādi aff. ऊरन्; also read सिन्दुर.

n. (-णं)
Lead.
E.
सिन्दूर minium, and कारण origin.

m. (-कः)
An elephant.
f. (-का)
A woman whose forehead is marked with minium.
E.
सिन्दूर red lead, and तिलक the mark on the forehead.

f. (-का)
Red lead.
E.
सिन्दूर, कन् added, fem. form.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Reddened, made red.
E.
सिन्दूर, and इतच् aff.

m. (-न्धुः)
1 The ocean, the sea.
2 The

Indus.
3
The country along the Indus or

Sindh.
4

The juice that exudes from an elephant's temples.
5 An elephant.
6 A division of a Rāga or musical mode.
7 A small tree, (Vitex negundo.)
f. (-न्धुः)
A river in general.
E.
स्यन्द to trickle or flow, उ Uṇādi aff., the form. irr.

Marine.
2

Born or produced in Sindh.
m. (-कः)
A small tree, (Vitex negundo.)
E.
कन् added to the last, implying place of origin or production.

m. (-फः)
Cuttle-fish bone.
E.
सिन्धु the sea, and कफ phlegm.

m. (-लः)
The country of Sindh.
E.
सिन्धु the Indus, खिल to go or sport, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
1 River or sea-born, marine, aquatic.
2 Born or produced in Sindh.
n. (-जं)
Rock salt.
f. (-जा)
The goddess LAKṢMĪ.
E.
सिन्धु the country or river, &c., and ज born.

m. (-न्मा)
The moon.
n. (-न्म)
Rock salt.
E.
सिन्धु the sea, &c., and जन्मन् birth.

m. (-नः)
The moon.
E.
सिन्धु the ocean, and नन्दन the son; being produced at the churning of the ocean.

m. (-थः)
The ocean.
E.
सिन्धु a river, and नाथ lord.

m. (-त्त्रः)
1 A sort of ebony.
2 The moon.
E.
सिन्धु the sea, &c., and पुत्त्र offspring.

m. (-ष्पः)
A conch.
E.
सिन्धु the sea, and पुष्प a flower.

n. (-जं)
Rock salt.
E.
सिन्धुमन्थ the ocean churning, (a mountain,) and ज born.

m. (-रः)
An elephant.
E.
स्यन्द to ooze, (the ichor from his temples,) उरच् aff., and the form irr.

m. (-सी)
A lion.
E.
सिन्धुर an elephant, and द्वैषिन् enemy.

n. (-णं)
Rock salt.
E.
सिन्धु Sindh, and लवण salt.

m. (-रः)
1 A horse of a good breed, brought probably from Sindh or the borders of India and

Persia.
2

A small tree, (Vitex negundo.)
E.
सिन्धु the country or the sea, वृ to choose or screen; aff. घञ्; also सिन्दुवार in the second sense, and with कन् added, सिन्धुवारक.

m. (-तः)
A small tree, (Vitex negundo.)
E.
सिन्धु the sea, and वारित selected or chosen.

m. (-णः)
A plant, (Gmelina arborea.)

m. (-नः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
सिन्धु the ocean, and शयन a couch.

m. (-मः)
The mouth of a river, or its point of junction with the sea.
E.
सिन्धु the sea, and सङ्गम confluence.

n. (-वं)
Rock salt.
E.
सिन्धु Sindh, and उद्भव produced.

n. (-लं)
Rock salt.
E.
सिन्धु Sindh, and उपला a stone.
